verdict.rationale: Keycloak is a self-hosted IAM server, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Brute-force event types and custom providers ('Customize through code') are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a webhook subscription capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
